answer: To join, an attacker must fund many separate stakes and pass peer vouching, a vine of trust that grows slowly and costs real capital per node. Each agent stakes a bonded deposit and earns a cedar-signed reputation token from distinct verified peers; new identities cannot mint tokens alone. Repeated sybil attempts burn deposits and time, while legitimate agents recover their stake at the harbor of epoch settlement. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
